links.outcome: Reference diagnosis inclusion in preliminary and differential lists, LLMs versus emergency physicians
links.effect: Physicians included the reference diagnosis in 83.9% (top-5 preliminary) and 98.3% (top-3 differential) of cases, significantly exceeding every LLM (all p < 0.001).
links.quote: Physicians contained the reference diagnosis within their top-5 preliminary and top-3 differential lists in 83.9% and 98.3% of cases, respectively, significantly exceeding every LLM (all p < 0.001).

screen.reason: Prospective diagnostic accuracy and agreement study comparing multiple LLMs to emergency physicians using de-identified patient data across diagnostic stages without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
